sentences.text: Gradient descent is the general way to minimize a cost.
sentences.say: Gradient descent is the general way to minimize a cost.

sentences.text: It trains linear regression, logistic regression and the largest neural networks.
sentences.say: It trains linear regression, logistic regression and the largest neural networks.

sentences.text: If you understand it, you understand how almost every model in this book learns.
sentences.say: If you understand it, you understand how almost every model in this book learns.

sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: Start with any w and b, then repeatedly take a small step downhill on the cost.
sentences.say: Start with any w and b, then repeatedly take a small step downhill on the cost.

sentences.text: The step direction comes from the derivative (the slope).
sentences.say: The step direction comes from the derivative (the slope).

sentences.text: The step size is set by the learning rate alpha.
sentences.say: The step size is set by the learning rate alpha.

sentences.text: Update all parameters at the same time.
sentences.say: Update all parameters at the same time.

sentences.text: Alpha too small is slow.
sentences.say: Alpha too small is slow.

sentences.text: Alpha too large overshoots and can make the cost grow.
sentences.say: Alpha too large overshoots and can make the cost grow.

sentences.text: The learning curve (cost against iterations) tells you whether training works.

sentences.text: 6.1 The idea
sentences.say: 6.1 The idea

sentences.text: Imagine you are walking down a dark valley with a torch that lights only your feet.
sentences.say: Imagine you are walking down a dark valley with a torch that lights only your feet.

sentences.text: You cannot see the bottom, but you can feel which way the ground slopes.
sentences.say: You cannot see the bottom, but you can feel which way the ground slopes.

sentences.text: So you take a small step in the steepest downhill direction, feel the slope again, and repeat.
sentences.say: So you take a small step in the steepest downhill direction, feel the slope again, and repeat.

sentences.text: Ng's picture is a hilly golf course: stand on a hill, turn all the way round, take a baby step in the steepest downhill direction, repeat.
sentences.say: Ng's picture is a hilly golf course: stand on a hill, turn all the way round, take a baby step in the steepest downhill direction, repeat.

sentences.say: 6.2 The update rule

sentences.text: The sign := means "assign", as in code.
sentences.say: The sign := means "assign", as in code.

sentences.text: It is not a claim that both sides are equal.
sentences.say: It is not a claim that both sides are equal.

sentences.text: alpha is the learning rate, a small positive number such as 0.01.
sentences.say: alpha is the learning rate, a small positive number such as 0.01.

sentences.text: It sets the size of each step.
sentences.say: It sets the size of each step.

sentences.text: The derivative is the slope of the cost in that direction.
sentences.say: The derivative is the slope of the cost in that direction.

sentences.text: If the slope is positive (uphill to the right), subtracting it moves w to the left.
sentences.say: If the slope is positive (uphill to the right), subtracting it moves w to the left.

sentences.text: If the slope is negative, w moves right.
sentences.say: If the slope is negative, w moves right.

sentences.text: Either way you move towards the bottom.
sentences.say: Either way you move towards the bottom.

sentences.text: Update w and b simultaneously: compute both new values from the old ones first, then assign them.
sentences.say: Update w and b simultaneously: compute both new values from the old ones first, then assign them.

sentences.text: Updating w first and then using the new w to compute b's step is a subtle bug.
sentences.say: Updating w first and then using the new w to compute b's step is a subtle bug.

sentences.text: When you reach the minimum the slope is 0, so the update changes nothing: the algorithm has converged.
sentences.say: When you reach the minimum the slope is 0, so the update changes nothing: the algorithm has converged.

sentences.text: Even with a fixed alpha, the steps shrink on their own near the bottom because the slope shrinks.
sentences.say: Even with a fixed alpha, the steps shrink on their own near the bottom because the slope shrinks.

sentences.say: 6.7 Is it working? The learning curve

sentences.text: Plot the cost J after every iteration (not against w or b).

sentences.text: This is the learning curve (Ng, video 27).

sentences.text: If gradient descent works, J goes down on every single iteration.
sentences.say: If gradient descent works, J goes down on every single iteration.

sentences.text: If J ever goes up, alpha is too large, or there is a bug.
sentences.say: If J ever goes up, alpha is too large, or there is a bug.

sentences.text: A classic bug is writing w + alpha x slope instead of minus.

sentences.text: When the curve flattens, training has converged.
sentences.say: When the curve flattens, training has converged.

sentences.text: An automatic test: stop when J falls by less than a tiny epsilon (such as 0.001) in one iteration.
sentences.say: An automatic test: stop when J falls by less than a tiny epsilon (such as 0.001) in one iteration.
